sentences.en: We have to conclude that the policy is a failure.
sentences.zh: 我们不得不得出结论，这项政策是失败的。

sentences.en: It goes without saying that honesty is the best policy.
sentences.zh: 不言而喻，诚实是最好的策略。

sentences.en: It is our policy not to give out personal information.
sentences.zh: 我们的原则是不会泄露个人资料。

senses.zh: （尤指政治、经济或商业方面的）政策，方针，策略；保险单；原则，为人之道
